name: complexity-optimizer
description: Performance doctor for AI coding agents. Finds O(n^2) loops, N+1 queries, sequential awaits, quadratic accumulation, and render-path hotspots; ranks the slowest functions with a health score; confirms with profilers and growth benchmarks. Produces safe optimization reports.

plugins.name: complexity-optimizer
plugins.description: Find performance bottlenecks and inefficient algorithms, ranked by function with a 0-100 health score. Finds nested loops, N+1 queries, sequential awaits, spread/concat accumulation, sorts inside loops, .includes() instead of Set, pandas row loops, and render-path transforms, then confirms with profilers and growth benchmarks. Report only by default — no files touched unless you ask.
